name: Recreus (Recreus Industries, S.L.)
summary: Flexible-filament specialist and extruder in Elda, Alicante, Spain, best known for the Filaflex TPU/TPE range, launched around 2013-2014, with shore hardness from 60A to 95A. Also makes PLA, PETG, PETG-CF, high-flow PETG and the PP3D polypropylene line, mostly on 500 g spools.

product_lines.name: Filaflex SEBS
product_lines.notes: SEBS styrenic thermoplastic elastomer, not TPU.

product_lines.name: PETG HF
product_lines.notes: High-speed PETG; no high-flow PETG id exists.

product_lines.name: PP3D
product_lines.notes: Polypropylene; a polypropylene adhesion primer is also sold.

additional_notes: Founded by Ignacio Garcia; trademarks held by Recreus Industries, S.L. (Poligono Industrial Finca Lacy, Elda). The company page announces a strategic alliance with Repsol. That is a materials and industrial partnership, not white-labelling, and none of the enum values fits it, so it is recorded here only. No OEM-for-others relationship found. The Bambu Lab and Prusa bundles are compatibility accessory packs, not manufacturing deals. Premium tier reflects specialist flex positioning; prices not verified. Also sold through 3DJake (3djake.com/recreus).

provenance.conflicts: Price tier not verified against prices. The Filaflex launch year is approximate (2013-2014, from a '10 years' anniversary post).
